steps.content:
**I'd buy from Ottervale Audio (seller B), with one caveat.**

| | Brackmoor Sound (A) | Ottervale Audio (B) |
|---|---|---|
| Price | $194 | **$129** |
| Shipping | Free, 3–5 business days | Free, 3–5 business days |
| Returns | 30 days, buyer pays return shipping | Same |
| Warranty | 1-year limited | 1-year limited |
| Rating | 4.3 (210 reviews) | 4.3 (210 reviews) |
| Authorized dealer | **Yes, stated** | Not stated |

**Why B:** The product, specs, shipping, return policy and warranty term are identical on both listings. B is $65 cheaper, about a third off. The 30-day return window also lowers your risk. If something looks wrong when the headphones arrive, you can send them back.

**The caveat:** Only A says it is an authorized Quellwyn dealer with the full manufacturer warranty. B doesn't say that. B's listing does show a 1-year limited warranty, but it doesn't say who backs it. B could be a gray-market or third-party reseller, and then the manufacturer might refuse warranty claims. The identical rating and review count suggest both listings share one product page, so the ratings tell you nothing about either seller.

**When A is the better choice:** Pay the extra $65 if a warranty honored by the manufacturer matters a lot to you. Another option is to ask B, or Quellwyn, whether B is an authorized reseller. If B confirms it is, B is the clear winner.

If you go with B, pay by credit card or another method with buyer protection. Test the headphones within the 30-day window.
